title: Fate's Twin
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's figure dissolved into the depths of darkness, and at that moment, a cold voice echoed from the edge of the Void—the voice of the Demonic Path Commander. The chess game of fate was far grander than Chen Ji had ever imagined.

text.content:
When the end of that chain entered Chen Ji's sight, his pupils contracted sharply—the existence at the end of fate was none other than the person he had been searching for all these years.

Ling Yuan slowly walked out from the depths of the black mist, surrounded by a faint cyan glow. His features remained as elegant and composed as ever, as if this were merely a chance meeting at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, rather than the culmination of ten thousand years of karmic entanglement. Only in the depths of those eyes burned a fire of obsession fierce enough to incinerate heaven and earth.

Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him suddenly grow scalding hot—an unprecedentedly intense reaction—as if some chain that had slumbered for ten thousand years was awakening, attempting to reconnect with another broken remnant.

A resonance of fate exploded between the two, a boundless power spanning ten millennia surging forth from the depths of the Void. Chen Ji felt his vision blur as countless fragments of light flashed before him like a passing parade—not visions of the future, but sealed memories.

The battlefield of ten thousand years ago, blood staining the heavens. Countless cultivators' corpses piled like mountains, and atop the highest altar, two figures stood side by side, jointly holding an ancient scroll radiating mysterious light—the complete Tianji Record, a supreme treasure bearing the Will of Heaven.

The faces of those two figures were identical to Ling Yuan and Chen Ji at this very moment.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's voice echoed through the darkness, carrying the vicissitudes and spite of ten thousand years. "You finally see it—the truth of ten thousand years ago."

His footsteps did not pause, approaching Chen Ji step by step. With each step, the cyan glow intensified, the pressure grew heavier.

"The inheritance of the Tianji Record was never a choice, but a severance." Ling Yuan's lips curved into an eerie arc, "It cleaved what should have been one into two halves—one bearing the future, the other bearing the past."

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his eyes holding no fear, no retreat—only a composure that ten thousand years of沧海桑田 could not erode. He looked at Ling Yuan as if looking at a pitiful chess piece.

"So you waited ten thousand years, just to fuse with me?"

His voice was terrifyingly calm, each word seeming to rise from the abyss of the Nine Hells.

"Ling Yuan—or rather, the failure abandoned by the Tianji Record ten thousand years ago." Chen Ji spoke each word deliberately, "What you call fate—is it Heaven's mandate, or just another cage?"

text.content:
Ling Yuan's footsteps finally stopped. He gazed quietly at Chen Ji, and in those eyes burning with obsession, a complex and indescribable emotion flickered—was it pity, mockery, or some feeling even he could not identify?

"Do you think I wanted this?"

Ling Yuan's voice suddenly dropped, carrying the weight and weariness of ten thousand years.

"The moment you obtained the Tianji Record, your fate was sealed. Every time you use your foresight, it consumes your Heavenly Fate Value—and all that consumption flows to another carrier." He slowly raised his hand, pointing to his own heart, "Far as the heavens, close as at hand."

Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Master Mo had told him that every use of the Tianji Record consumed Heavenly Fate Value, but never mentioned where that consumption went. So—it was all arranged long ago.

He suddenly thought of those blurry visions of the future. Whenever Chen Nian appeared in those visions, everything became hazy, as if two forces were tearing at each other.

"My sister..." Chen Ji's voice suddenly dropped, "Is she also a piece in this chess game?"

Ling Yuan's laughter echoed through the empty Void, carrying an ineffable implication.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's smile gradually faded, replaced by a近乎虔诚的狂热 fervor.

"Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—what it locks is the bond of fate between us." His voice was low and dangerous, "The Holy Sect took her, not for any goddamn Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

Ling Yuan stepped forward again, and this time his aura surged dramatically. The entire Void trembled beneath his might.

"Enough, Chen Ji. The drama of ten thousand years of reincarnation is about to end." His eyes fixed on Chen Ji, "You have only two choices—fuse with me and share the complete power of the Tianji Record; or—"

"Or, be forcibly devoured by me."

His words were like blades, each word striking at the heart. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record Fragment within him tremble violently, as if quaking in anticipation of the coming clash of fates.

Two gazes collided in the Void—one the failure of ten thousand years ago, the other the inheritor of today. Similar faces, different fates, yet now they stood at the crossroads of destiny.

text.content:
However, at this moment of supreme tension, an异样 flickered through Chen Ji's eyes.

Master Mo within the Tianji Record Fragment had once said—every time he unsealed a page of knowledge, he would tell Chen Ji the part he needed to hear, not the complete truth. Then, could the truth of the Tianji Record's inheritance also hide a third possibility yet to be revealed?

Chen Ji's mind raced. The prophecy of ten thousand years ago, the fate of the twin children of destiny, the existence of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—all the fragments collided and reorganized within the depths of his consciousness.

Suddenly, a Spiritual Light flashed through his Mental Sea like lightning.

A slow smile curved Chen Ji's lips—that grin显得格外刺眼 beneath Ling Yuan's pressure.

"Fusion? Devouring?"

He laughed softly, that laughter echoing through the silent Void, carrying both mockery and pity.

"Ling Yuan, you constantly preach that fate cannot be defied, yet have you ever wondered—why did the Tianji Record split us apart?"

Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, pointing to the faintly visible thread of fate between them.

"If fusion were the only correct answer, why would the Tianji Record bother with this?" His eyes were deep as an abyss, "What it awaits is not our merging—but a third path."

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's expression finally changed. In those eyes burning with obsession, the first sign of wavering appeared.

"A third path?"

His voice carried a barely perceptible tremor, as if this phrase had touched the most vulnerable corner of his ten-thousand-year obsession.

"Do you think I never considered it?" Ling Yuan's voice suddenly rose, "For ten thousand years, I searched endlessly, attempted countless times—yet all paths ultimately led to the same ending!"

He suddenly raised his hand, a beam of cyan light shooting straight toward Chen Ji's throat.

"Since you insist on seeking death, I shall grant your wish!"

choice.prompt: The scales of fate have already tilted. At this moment that decides everything, how will you choose?

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan insists on violence, then let us fight! Fight to end violence, kill to stop killing. Let this madman obsessed for ten thousand years witness what true Heavenly Secrets inheritance truly means!
choices.visible_reward: Verify your strength, suppress Ling Yuan's madness
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's power accumulated over ten thousand years cannot be underestimated—direct confrontation will surely exact a price

text.content: Chen Ji's form suddenly erupted, the tattered Tianji Record Fragment blooming with brilliant golden light in his palm. He faced the ten-thousand-year nemesis with a mortal's body, each strike bearing the weight of fate.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply—he sensed the essence of that power. This was no simple contest of spiritual energy, but a collision between the very sources of the Tianji Record!

"You—!" For the first time, true shock colored Ling Yuan's voice, "This is impossible!"

choices.description: The essence of fate's twins is power from the same source. Rather than both sides being injured, why not proactively attempt fusion—unite past and future, creating new possibilities.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the complete power of the Tianji Record, fully unraveling the mystery of ten thousand years
choices.risk_hint: Fusion means surrendering part of the self—no one knows where this path leads

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, proactively releasing his suppression of the Tianji Record. He let that power spanning ten millennia flood into his body, creating resonance with Ling Yuan's aura.

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan's movements suddenly halted. He sensed that familiar yet alien power—the primordial force of the same source, attempting to merge with him.

"You... actually dare?" Ling Yuan's voice held disbelief, "Are you not afraid of losing yourself?"

choices.description: Ling Yuan is merely another pitiful soul toyed with by the Tianji Record. Chen Ji chooses to uncover the truth of the third possibility—the twin children of fate are not meant to fuse or destroy each other, but to together break this ten-thousand-year chess game!
choices.visible_reward: Awaken Ling Yuan's inner doubts, shake his ten-thousand-year obsession, creating a turning point for breaking the situation

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat, did not counterattack. He simply gazed quietly at Ling Yuan, his eyes holding pity, understanding, yet no fear whatsoever.

dialogue.content:
"The third path lies not between you and me." Chen Ji's voice was calm as still water, yet each word rang like thunder, "It lies within the Tianji Record itself. Ten thousand years ago it split us apart, not for us to destroy each other—but waiting for a will strong enough to end the fate it has been exploited for."

Ling Yuan's attack ceased abruptly.

text.content:
Ling Yuan's offensive suddenly halted. In those eyes burning with obsession, ten-thousand-year waves of doubt finally appeared.

"End the Tianji Record's fate?" His voice carried a hint of mockery, yet couldn't hide the trembling beneath, "Do you think the Eye of Heavenly Mandate will sit by and do nothing?"

Chen Ji slowly shook his head, that smile of his growing increasingly profound.

"What the Eye of Heavenly Mandate desires has never been us—it wants an endlessly循环的棋局." He spoke each word deliberately, "Our true enemy has never been each other."

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan fell silent.

Ten thousand years of obsession cracked at this moment. He gazed at Chen Ji as if examining an existence he had never seen before.

"You... truly are not afraid?" His voice was low and weary, "Afraid that in the moment you uncover the truth, you will become the Eye of Heavenly Mandate's new chess piece?"

Chen Ji met Ling Yuan's gaze directly, his eyes reflecting the fate of twin children of destiny—two trajectories separated for ten thousand years, about to meet for the final time.

text.content:
Ling Yuan's form gradually faded into the darkness, leaving only a wistful sigh.

"I will be watching you, Chen Ji."

His voice was ethereal as wind, carrying the weight and weariness of ten thousand years.

"If you truly can find the third path—I await the spectacle."

Chen Ji stood alone in the empty Void, the Tianji Record Fragment within him slowly calming. He knew the true chess game had just begun—and Ling Yuan's test was far from over.

In the distance, a cold gaze pierced through layers of mist, observing all this.

The Demonic Path Commander.

She gazed at the direction where Ling Yuan dissolved, at Chen Ji's solitary figure, her lips curving into a meaningful arc.

"The twin children of fate, finally meeting..."

Her voice carried both anticipation and calculation.

"Interesting. This game grows more fascinating by the moment."

The wheels of fate turned once more, and Chen Ji stood at the eye of the storm.
